confidence_notes: Holistic model estimates from general knowledge and the supplied comparables; no live menus, booking pages or listings were checked. Restaurant and cafe anchors are moderately reliable. Hotel rates vary widely by district and season, and July falls in Indonesia's school holiday period. Cocktail and wine anchors are derived from the beer anchor using typical bar multiples and are the least certain. FX: the 13 Oct 2026 RBA observation comes from search-result summaries of the RBA overview page, not a direct page read. An unconfirmed 14 Oct homepage reading of 0.7002 was not used.
comparable_city_reasoning: Calibrated to the supplied Yogyakarta, Chiang Mai and Vientiane observations. Jakarta is a larger, costlier capital, so cafe, meal and hostel anchors sit above Yogyakarta and near or above Chiang Mai. Hotel anchors sit near Chiang Mai and Vientiane levels, with a central-Jakarta premium on three-star rooms. Beer sits above the comparables, reflecting Indonesia's alcohol taxes. Cocktail and wine are set as multiples of the beer anchor.
